summary: Currently enrolled students who sign up with an eligible academic email receive $35 wallet credit automatically. Eligible domains include .edu and international academic suffixes such as .ac.in, .edu.in, .edu.au, .ac.uk, .edu.sg, .ac.id, .edu.my, .ac.th, .edu.vn and .edu.ph, plus named university domains; check the official FAQ's supported list. Contact community@tinyfish.ai if your academic domain is not covered, not simply because it is non-.edu. The program also runs a monthly Bounty Board: approved agentic apps earn a $50 gift card, Skills $20, and prompts $10. Gift-card eligibility starts from day one, but awards require approved work. Sign up at agent.tinyfish.ai and use the same email at tinybounties.com for bounty submissions.
claim_steps: Sign up at agent.tinyfish.ai with a currently enrolled student's eligible academic email — $35 wallet credit is added automatically. Check the official FAQ's supported suffixes and university-domain list.
If your academic email domain is not covered by the official list, email community@tinyfish.ai.
Sign in at tinybounties.com with the same email to claim a monthly bounty, build it, and submit repo/social links for gift-card review. Approved apps earn $50, Skills $20 and prompts $10.

social_proof.title: TinyFish Student Program. Free credits, real bounties, and proof of work.
social_proof.text: Anyone enrolled can join, build and earn. The $35 wallet credit is automatic with an eligible academic email address. Check the supported domains in the FAQs, or email community@tinyfish.ai if yours is not covered.

social_proof.title: TinyFish student FAQ — international academic email suffixes
social_proof.text: Academic email addresses ending in these suffixes are eligible: US: .edu; India: .ac.in, .edu.in; Australia: .edu.au; UK: .ac.uk; Singapore: .edu.sg; Indonesia: .ac.id; Malaysia: .edu.my; Thailand: .ac.th; Vietnam: .edu.vn; Philippines: .edu.ph.
